text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.757.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.757.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain v0.60.757.0 is installed as a keyless local brain and connected to Hermes as an MCP server. Remember and recall work with real GBrain calls from the command line. I couldn't confirm a recall from inside a Hermes session: my attempt hung and was killed after 280 seconds, so that check is still open.

**What's verified**
- `gbrain --version` prints `gbrain 0.60.757.0` (checked out at the `v0.60.757.0` tag).
- Keyless setup: local PGLite database, embeddings off, no API keys. Setup migrations finished with exit 0.
- `hermes mcp test gbrain` connected and found the 8 memory tools (remember, recall, forget, entity, context_pack, delta, request_tools, synthesize).
- Round trip:
  - `gbrain remember "gbrain install check marker 2026-11-21 hermes" --provenance install-check` saved it as fact #1.
  - A separate `gbrain recall --query "gbrain install check marker"` returned fact #1 with provenance `install-check`.
  - `gbrain search "install check marker"` found it by exact keyword.
- Your identity is untouched: `SOUL.md` has the same checksum as before, and the only config change is a new `mcp_servers.gbrain` block in `/harness-state/hermes/config.yaml`.

**Not verified**
- **Recall inside Hermes:** `hermes -z` printed nothing on the first try and hung on the second. My guess is the inner session couldn't use the model provider or the brain while this session had them, but I haven't confirmed that. Start a new Hermes session and ask it to "recall the gbrain install check marker". Once it answers, run `gbrain forget 1` to delete the test fact.
- **gbrain's own health check:** `gbrain doctor --only harness_wiring` doesn't detect this Hermes setup and reports "no harness detected". That is a gap in its detection, not a failed connection: the MCP test above passed.
- I didn't save a second test note of your choosing, which the install guide also suggests.

**How it was installed:** this unattended session's safety checks blocked the guide's usual commands (the Bun installer script and `bun install -g`). I used the guide's other routes instead:
- The official Bun 1.4.4 binary, placed at `/harness-state/.bun/bin/bun`.
- A git clone of the tag at `/harness-state/gbrain`, set up with `bun install` and `bun link`.

The brain itself is in `/harness-state/.gbrain/`. I didn't add Bun to your shell profile, so run `export PATH="/harness-state/.bun/bin:$PATH"` before calling `gbrain` by hand. Hermes doesn't need it; its config uses absolute paths.

**Search mode (Step 3.5): `conservative` is in effect.** Setup picked it automatically because there is no chat key or reranker. You can change it any time:

```
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```

  1) conservative (in effect): 4K budget, at most 10 chunks, no reranker. Best for cheap or high-volume use.
  2) balanced: 12K budget, 25 chunks, reranked. Reranking needs a provider key.
  3) tokenmax: no budget, 50 chunks, reranked. The widest retrieval.

To switch, run `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>`, then `gbrain search modes` to confirm. Search is keyword-only and nothing leaves this machine. These estimates are not what your own model subscription charges.

**Other settings in effect** (change any time):
- **Saving facts automatically:** off, so it only saves what you ask it to remember. gbrain recommends `gbrain config set memory.auto_writeback salient`.
- **Upkeep:** free upkeep runs while a gbrain session is open. Turn it off with `gbrain config set maintenance.auto false`.
- **Conversation archive:** on, kept locally. Turn it off with `gbrain transcripts archive off`.
- **Extra skills:** none installed. `gbrain skillpack scaffold --all` adds them.

Nothing else was added: no API keys, cron jobs, background services or paid features.
